ast_normalization: SHA-256 of Python 3.11 ast.dump(Module(body=selected top-level definitions, type_ignores=[]), include_attributes=False), recursively omitting imports and empty type_params fields added by newer Python versions. Captured from the original workstation sources; tests compare released definitions without requiring that workstation. Main hashes inline the extracted selector-constructor assignments before comparison.

known_limitations: Robot, recorder and websocket-client startup occur before the rollout try/finally; startup failures can skip normal robot.disconnect cleanup. Exception-safe hardware teardown is not validated by this export.

Historical workstation AHS behavior is preserved: FFT length shrinks to min(remaining episode steps, trace horizon, action horizon), and filtering candidate horizons resets Beta state. This differs from the public fixed-full-horizon FFT selector.
Selector history records policy action prefixes, not post-clipping/EMA/gating commands actually sent to the robot.
Offline tests do not validate robot motion, camera I/O, CAN/Dora integration, network service behavior, or real-time scheduling.
Saved poses, recordings, checkpoints, device calibration, and other workstation state are deliberately excluded.
